verdict.rationale: Rive mentions a CLI that lets an agent generate content (rive-docs-26), and RML provides a text and XML representation for building .riv files outside the Editor (rive-docs-20/25). The open-source runtime loads files, advances state machines and draws through an abstract Renderer interface (rive-gh-1), which suggests non-interactive use is possible. However, nothing documents headless or CI execution itself, and the CLI is only a single marketing line. Missing for 10: documented CLI commands and usage, explicit headless/CI mode or examples (e.g. exporting or validating .riv in a pipeline), auth for unattended runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
